about.title: About Resolia
about.intro: Resolia helps you understand everyday household problems (repairs, cleaning, clothing, garden, and more) and gives you clear steps to fix them.
about.howItWorksBody: You take a photo or pick one from your gallery, tell us what's going on, and the app shows you a likely cause and a step-by-step guide. Right now, the analysis is generated from example data simulated inside the app, not by an online AI service.
about.statusBody: This is a version still under development. We're getting the architecture ready to connect a real AI-powered analysis later on, at no extra cost to you for now.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.analysisBody: Right now, your problem's analysis is generated from example data simulated inside the app itself: the photo you take or pick is never sent to any server or AI service. It's only used to show it back to you on the result screen.
privacy.historyBody: An analysis is only saved to your history when you tap "Save to history". It's stored only on this device (not on a server), and you can delete a single analysis or clear your entire history at any time from the History screen.
privacy.accountsBody: Resolia doesn't ask you to create an account or provide personal data like your name, email, or phone number yet. The language you choose and today's free-analysis counter are also stored only on this device.
privacy.permissionsBody: The app asks for camera access to photograph your problem, and gallery access to pick an existing image. If you don't grant a permission, you simply won't be able to use that particular feature; the rest of the app keeps working.

faqs.question: How do I analyze a problem?
faqs.answer: From Home, tap "Analyze a problem" to take a photo, or "Choose from gallery" to use an image you already have. You can also tap a category to jump straight to the camera with that context.

faqs.question: How many free analyses do I get per day?
faqs.answer: You get 3 free analyses per day. The counter resets automatically when a new day starts.

faqs.question: How do I save a result to my history?
faqs.answer: On the result screen, tap "Save to history". You'll be able to view, rate, or delete it later from the History tab.

faqs.question: How do I change the app's language?
faqs.answer: Go to Profile and tap "Language" to switch between Spanish and English. The app will remember your choice next time you open it.

faqs.question: What happens if I deny camera or gallery access?
faqs.answer: You can keep using the rest of the app as normal. You'll only need to grant that permission when you want to use that specific feature.
